basic_info.main_problem: 因债务较多且部分课程not及格而感到失败与overwhelmed，这些感受自本学期开始出现并逐步加重，伴随回避上课、社交隔离与对not yet来的Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of failure have significantly affected my mental health and academic performance.

core_beliefs: 一切It is all my fault

special_situations.event: 收到债务提醒（账单/催款信息）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我背负很多债务或出现财务问题，就说明我这个人失败且not负责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids checking bills, reduces contact with others to evade evaluation; tries budgeting to control spending to make up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这It is all my fault，我把一切都搞砸了

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not通过考试或学习落后，就证明我在各方面都not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids classes, wants to give up; or doubles effort in the short term to prove herself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在各个方面都失败了

special_situations.event: 面对学业挑战、意识到本学期落后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦我现在跟not上，就永远追not回来了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdrawal并与同学/朋友保持距离，减少求助

special_situations.event: 准备去上课或想到需要出门见人/上课
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在去上课，会应付not了、丢脸
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过not上课来短期降低Anxiety与羞耻感

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被理解并证明自己是有能力的
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被他人negate与羞辱、害怕对not yet来失控
defense_goal: 通过回避上课和Reduced socializing来避免暴露短板、减少羞耻
Gaining a sense of control through self-blame and taking responsibility onto myself

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、需要独自承担一切后果的人
object_relations.object_representation: 他人会评判、失望，难以提供支持

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在咨询中被邀请检视成绩not佳与债务相关证据和反证时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将复杂外部因素简化为“都是我not好”，把外部压力内化为自我攻击（移情倾向：将负性评价想象为来自自体）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、去责备，先验证其羞耻与Anxiety，再协助区分多重原因与可控因素；use开放式Questioning，鼓励具体化事件与证据平衡，避免Reinforcement自责。

manifestations: Proactively isolates from friends and family, hard to open up about distress to others
感觉without人支持，独自承担债务与Academic pressure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁以“It is all my fault/I am a failure”为主的自我苛责叙述
难以向他人求助或敞开，担心被负面评价
When talking about academics and debt, overly introspects and blames herself, reducing real contact

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Could have sought help from classmates/teachers/family but chose to bear the pressure alone
将向外的求助与表达转为自我指责与Withdrawal

positive_force: 曾有Good的学业表现与财务管理经验（过往有好成绩并能管理开支）
具备自我Reflection与证据平衡的能力（能承认过去成功，非总是失败）
已主动尝试预算与增加学习投入等策略
negative_force: 自我贴标签（失败者）、A cognitive pattern of overgeneralization and personalization
灾难化与对not yet来的负性预测导致回避行为
回避上课与社交隔离，减少外部支持与反馈
Weak social support，难以向他人敞开与求助

antecedent: 面对学业挑战或意识到本学期进度落后

target_behavior.core_reason: 将学业挫折灾难化并过度概括为“我在各方面都失败”，伴随个人化与强烈羞耻，Weak social supportReinforcement了回避倾向
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避被评价与失败感以降低当下Anxiety/羞耻
target_behavior.consequence: 学业进一步受损、压力加剧，Self-efficacy下降，形成恶性循环

target_behavior.behavior: 社交隔离/减少与他人接触
antecedent: 想到需要与朋友/家人交流近况
经历学业挫折后对他人评价的担忧
target_behavior.core_reason: 个人化与自我贴标签引发的羞耻与自责，担心被负面评价，因而将求助冲动转向自我指责与Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: 避免暴露“失败”的自己，短期降低被评判的风险与Anxiety
